section_summary.extract_value: This is a cross-sectional face-to-face interview study conducted in Saudi Arabia with 207 middle-aged women (45-65 years old) recruited from nine primary health centers in Hofuf city over a three-month period (October-December 2017). Data were collected through individual interviews conducted by trained female nutritionists, with anthropometric measurements taken to assess BMI. The study employed convenience sampling with specific inclusion criteria excluding pregnant/breastfeeding women and those with chronic illnesses.
